functional_decoder.hardware: one Blackhole P300 chip per process (1x1 mesh); default suite on TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, context tests on TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1
functional_decoder.device_dram_bytes_allocatable_source: ttnn.get_memory_view(mesh_device, ttnn.BufferType.DRAM): 8 banks x 4272341376 bytes free on a fresh device
notes: The HF-advertised 40960-token context is retained in full; no capability reduction was needed.
Full-context prefill and decode evidence uses real layer-0 weights and a float32 chunked torch reference validated against the HF Qwen3DecoderLayer.
The batch-32 full-context cache (5.37 GB for one layer) fits in device DRAM with the layer weights; the full 36-layer stack is sized by later stages.

Prefill SDPA chunks and the decode K chunk are chosen so the kernels' padded K window never extends past the page-table row (tt-metal chunked/paged SDPA pad Sk to the chunk size and follow the page table that far; see functional_decoder/tt_metal_sdpa_padded_k/). A page-table extent that is a multiple of 256 positions gets the largest chunks; any multiple of 32 is correct.
Decode uses one current_pos int32 tensor per user for cache update, attention length and the on-device RoPE lookup; trace replay refreshes only token, current_pos and page-table contents.

optimized_decoder.hardware: one Blackhole P300 chip per process (1x1 mesh, p150 mesh graph descriptor); default suite on TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1, Tracy profiles on TT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
optimized_decoder.device_dram_bytes_allocatable_source: ttnn.get_memory_view(mesh_device, ttnn.BufferType.DRAM): 8 banks x 4272341376 bytes free on a fresh device
optimized_decoder.kv_cache_dtype_note: BF16 paged cache, as in the functional and fused stages. A BFP8 cache was measured (doc/optimized_decoder/experiments/exp7.json, exp10.json): 2 to 3 percent faster at batch 32, unchanged at batch 1, but one of 32 users with a 32-token prefix falls to output PCC 0.9942 against HF (bar 0.995; 0.9993 with the BF16 cache), so BFP8 is rejected for this stage. The decoder supports either dtype (allocate_kv_cache(dtype=...); QWEN3_KV_CACHE_DTYPE=bfp8 in the tests).

full_attention.decode_residual_layout: L1 width-sharded [1, 1, 32, 4096] over the first 32 cores of the compute grid (row-major); DRAM-interleaved [1, 1, B, 4096] also accepted

notes: The HF-advertised 40960-token context is retained in full; the optimized decoder changes weight dtypes (386 MB BF16 to 180 MB BFP8/BFP4 per layer, 360 MB resident with the interleaved prefill copy) and keeps the BF16 KV cache (167.8 MB per user per layer at full context).

DRAM budget on one chip (34.18 GB allocatable): 36 layers of weights 6.47 GB sharded plus 6.47 GB interleaved copy; BF16 cache 6.04 GB per user at full context over 36 layers; the full-model stage sizes batch and context against its own buffers and may drop the prefill copy.
optimized_decoder.weight_copy_note: Prefill chunks up to 256 rows use an interleaved copy of each projection weight (ttnn.linear); the DRAM-sharded copy serves decode and longer prefill chunks. Resident weight bytes are twice weight_bytes_per_layer unless OptimizedPolicy.prefill_interleaved_copy_max_rows is 0.
